d: Deep within dense, uncharted forests, elite trackers and field scientists deploy military-grade technology to investigate reports of an elusive apex predator. Across this gripping compilation showcasing the best of S4, researchers document shocking cryptid encounters in deep wilderness as massive figures stalk perimeter lines under the cover of total darkness. Setting up advanced bioacoustic recorders across remote valleys, the team captures terrifying Bigfoot audio screams and clues found echoing through the midnight canopy, leaving seasoned wilderness experts rattled.
